physicalEvidence.status: verified collaborative learned physical execution; local apparatus ownership and access unconfirmed
physicalEvidence.summary: Large Video Planner, first posted December 2025 and revised May 8, 2026, uses a learned 14B video diffusion planner, hand/depth reconstruction and kinematic retargeting to execute actions on a real Franka Panda with parallel gripper and a Unitree G1 arm with Inspire hand. The full methods specify 15 Hz and 5 Hz execution respectively. Physical trials are separate from third-party evaluation of generated videos. Planning takes several minutes on an A100 and execution is explicitly open-loop; this is not a real-time reactive VLA controller. Success varies considerably by task; some humanoid trials used added gripper tape for friction/torque limitations. The active advisee link supports substantive group involvement, but apparatus ownership/location and Freeman-specific hardware access are unresolved in this multi-university collaboration.
